stage1AtCapWithoutConfirmationRule: Stage 1 at cap without confirmation = STOP. Never run Stage 1 to its registered cap and then enter Stage 2 on an unconfirmed outcome or without headroom for Stage 2's planned spend — halt and escalate for re-authorization (apply the degradation ladder first) instead.
